description: Execute a SPARQL query against the DBpedia public endpoint.

examples.query: SELECT ?resource ?label WHERE { ?resource a dbo:Person ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER (LANG(?label) = 'en') } LIMIT 10
SELECT ?city ?population WHERE { ?city a dbo:City ; dbo:populationTotal ?population . } ORDER BY DESC(?population) LIMIT 5

query.description: SPARQL query text. Also accepts `sparql` as an alias — the wikidata_sparql_query tool uses that name for the same argument.

name: sparql

head.description: Query result header with variable names

body.description: Query results as raw text in specified format

title: Sparql
